page: OVHcloud t1-90 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The system is provisioned with 18 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon Silver 4214 processor clocked at 3.0 GHz, alongside 90.0 GB of system memory. For hardware acceleration, it bundles two NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs providing a combined 32 GB of VRAM (16 GB per GPU). Fast local storage is included via an 800 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Note that complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

Benchmark results highlight strong specialized compute capabilities driven by the dual Volta GPUs, particularly in AI inference workloads. The instance achieves top-tier performance on medium 7B model prompt processing (1312.34 tokens/sec) and text generation (116.68 tokens/sec), as well as top-tier prompt processing for small 135M models (14375.81 tokens/sec). Performance for 70B parameter models drops to the middle tier for prompt processing (16.27 tokens/sec), constrained by the 32 GB total VRAM envelope.

In contrast to its GPU performance, the CPU side reflects standard general-purpose metrics. Single-thread processing registers in the lower quartile, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1046.0 and stress-ng single-core score of 1294.89. Multi-threaded workloads show middle-tier performance, marked by a Geekbench multi-core score of 7836.0, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 107.41 GB/sec, and Redis throughput at 20.05 million operations/sec.

Given its hardware distribution and benchmark outcomes, the OVHcloud t1-90 represents a cost-effective platform for machine learning inference, small-to-medium LLM deployments, computer vision pipelines, and GPU-accelerated batch data processing. It is less suited for workloads that strictly bottleneck on single-threaded CPU throughput or require massive single-GPU VRAM allocations.
description: OVHcloud t1-90 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine tailored for machine learning and parallel computing workloads. Driven by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture, it features 18 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon Silver 4214 processor running at 3.0 GHz, paired with 90.0 GB of RAM. The instance incorporates dual NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs totaling 32 GB of VRAM, an 800 GB local NVMe SSD, and 4 Gbps baseline networking. In benchmark assessments, t1-90 demonstrates top-tier throughput in small and medium LLM inference, delivering 1312.34 tokens/sec for 7B model prompt processing. Conversely, its host CPU scores in the lower quartile for single-threaded tasks and the middle tier for multi-threaded computations. The server delivers balanced cost efficiency for GPU-focused pipelines, including model serving, computer vision, and accelerated data processing.
